context: Inventory of all technical and non-technical talks, workshops, seminars given by Dattatreya Vellal across career 2007–2021. Derived from folder structure at /Career/My Talks/Technical and /Career/My Talks/Non Technical. Cross-referenced with resume givebacks sections for dates and venues.
raw_text:
=== TECHNICAL TALKS ===

1. Face Detection & Recognition (RVCE 2007)
Presentation on Face Detection and Recognition. Created during final year at R.V. College of Engineering, 2007.

2. Web 2.0 - An Introduction (CSI Talk, multiple venues, 2009-2012)
CSI talk on Web 2.0 introduction. Delivered at Jain College (8th Feb), CMR-IMS Bangalore (21 June 2012), and multiple other venues. Covers Ajax, JavaScript, social networking technologies.

3. JavaScript & Ajax (CSI Talk)
CSI talk covering JavaScript and Ajax technologies. Delivered at multiple academic institutions.

4. J2EE Introduction
Introduction to Java Enterprise Edition. Delivered at GMIT (9 Oct 2013) and multiple other venues.

5. IDEs - Your Next Programming Platform (IBM University Relations Webinar, Oct 2012 + multiple venues)
Talk on why IDEs should be adopted as the programming platform in colleges. Delivered via IBM University Relations and IBM India Technical Experts Council Tech-Talk series to colleges across India. IBM Technical Experts Council webinar recording available. Also delivered at GMIT Oct 2013.

6. Visual Component/Project Dependency Management (RVCE CCT-2010, 22 Jan 2010)
Presentation at National Conference on Computing, Communication and Technology (CCT-2010) at R.V. College of Engineering. Topic: Visual Component Dependency Management. IEEE paper submitted.

7. QSE 2009 Symposium - Visual Project Dependency Manager
Quality Software Engineering 2009 India level poster/paper presentation on Visual Project Dependency Manager.

8. Design Patterns - An Introduction (Multiple venues, 2011-2015)
Introduction to Design Patterns. Delivered at: National Seminar on Object Modeling and Design Patterns at NHCE (4 Nov 2011); RNSIT (16 March 2013); Exeter Software internally (July 2014); CSI Bangalore Chapter workshop (April 2015); multiple other venues.

9. Design Patterns - Advanced (Multiple venues, 2014-2015)
Advanced Design Patterns with program examples. Delivered at Exeter University (Aug 2014); CSI BC Workshop (April 2015).

10. 4G Internet & Associated Technologies (MVJCE, 14 Aug 2013)
Opening talk on Internet and its evolution at National Workshop on 4G Internet & Associated Technologies at MVJ College of Engineering, 14 Aug 2013.

11. Behind the Scene Technologies of the Social-Net (BMSIT, 14 Sept 2013)
Technical seminar on behind-the-scenes technologies of social networking at B.M.S. Institute of Technology, 14 Sept 2013.

12. Struts and Hibernate (MVJCE, 28 Sept 2013)
Technical seminar on Struts and Hibernate web frameworks at MVJ College of Engineering, 28 Sept 2013.

13. Advanced Java & J2EE (Marwadi Education Foundation Gujarat, 21-22 Sept 2013)
Two-day hands-on workshop on Advanced Java and J2EE concepts at Marwadi Education Foundation, Gujarat. 21-22 Sept 2013.

14. J2EE and Advanced Java (GMIT Davanagere, 9 Nov 2013)
One-day workshop at GM Institute of Technology, Davanagere.

15. Android Applications Development (VVIET Mysore, 10-11 April 2013 / VVIT April 2014)
Two-day workshop on Android Application Development at Vidya Vikas Institute of Engineering and Technology (VVIET) Mysore. Also VVIT Mysore 10th April 2014.

16. Java Programming Contest - Java Jazz (MVJCE, 23 April 2014 + 29 April 2014)
Java Programming Contest organized at MVJ College of Engineering. Two sessions with questionnaire, answer key and score sheets.

17. Agile-like Adoptions (Exeter Internal, 2014)
Internal talk at Exeter Software India on Agile-like adoptions. Delivered to engineering team.

18. Web Technologies & Us (BMSIT MCA Seminar, 19 Dec 2015)
Seminar on Web Technologies and the world at BMSIT MCA. December 2015.

19. Social Media & The World of Microservices (SIT Tumkur, 2019)
Talk on Social Media and Microservices at Siddaganga Institute of Technology Tumkur, 2019. Part of University Relations series.

20. SOLID Principles of OO Design & Programming (RVCE University Relations, 2018)
Talk on SOLID Principles of Object-Oriented Design and Programming. Delivered at R.V. College of Engineering via University Relations program, 2018.

21. Coding Dojo - HSDP Copenhagen (Philips, 2018-2021)
Coding Dojo sessions run at Philips Health Suite Digital Platform Copenhagen team. String Calculator kata and kickoff sessions.

22. Structured Architecture (Philips, Bangalore)
Multi-day structured architecting workshop. 4 day sessions (DAY 1-4). Delivered in Bangalore via Philips.

23. IBM Scaling New Heights - What's the Secret?
Talk on career growth and technical excellence. IBM internal.

24. Visual Component Dependency Management (IEEE submission)
IEEE paper submission on Visual Component Dependency Management, 2009-2010.

25. My Patent - US20120150789A1
Presentation/documentation of USPTO patent US20120150789A1 (Determining and Conveying User Availability). Filed Dec 2010, published Oct 2013.

26. Dattatreya S Vellal - The Journey So Far
Personal career journey talk. Technical retrospective on career path.

27. TExeter Thursday Series (Exeter Software, 2013-2015)
Year-long internal Tech/Fun session series at Exeter Software India:
- TExeter Thursday #1: Quiz, TExeter Times newsletter Issue 1
- TExeter Thursday #2: Quiz with Java programming challenge
- TExeter Thursday #3: Tech Bucket Challenge (Chocbucket), Doodle
- TExeter Thursday #5: TExpressions quiz
Organized by Datta to improve engagement and cross-team collaboration.

=== NON-TECHNICAL TALKS ===

28. Stress Management (YIC, Aug-Nov 2009)
Seminar on Stress Management delivered at Young India Concepts (YIC), August-November 2009. Yoga and wellness context.

29. Yoga - The Need of the Hour
Introductory talk on Yoga and its need in modern life. Delivered at various occasions.

30. Yoga - The Introduction
Introductory session on Yoga principles and practice.

31. PanchakoshaViveka (Annamalai University Bangalore Chapter, 27 April 2014)
Seminar on Pancha Kosha Viveka (five layers of human existence in yoga philosophy) at Annamalai University Bangalore Chapter, 27 April 2014.

32. 7 Tools for Life
Personal development talk on 7 tools/principles for life. Non-technical personal growth session.

33. Attitude Towards Learning (BMSIT University Relations, Dec 2018 + others)
Talk on attitude towards learning. Delivered at BMSIT via University Relations program, December 2018. Also delivered at other institutions.

34. Career Development
Talk on career development for students and young professionals.

35. How to Conduct Effective Meetings (Blue Expression Toastmasters)
Toastmasters Leadership Academy (BETC LA) talk on conducting effective meetings.

36. How to Deal with Uncertainty / How to Handle Uncertainty (SIT Tumkur, 2020)
Talk on dealing with uncertainty. Delivered at SIT Tumkur via University Relations, 2020. Distribution material prepared.

37. Do We Teach Our Children How to Deal with Uncertainty
Extended talk/workshop on parenting and teaching children to handle uncertainty.

38. How to Prepare for Interviews (RVCE 2017, NIE 2017, Vemana IT 2017, BMSIT 2018)
Talk on interview preparation for students. Delivered at multiple institutions: RVCE (2017), NIE Mysore (2017), Vemana Institute of Technology (2017), BMSIT (2018). Includes full notes.

39. How to Give a Good Presentation / How to Prepare a Good Presentation
Workshop on presentation skills. Delivered at multiple venues.

40. So.. You Have to Give a Good Speech (Toastmasters)
Toastmasters speech on how to give a good speech. With distribution material.

41. Think on Your Feet / Tips to Give a Better Tech Presentation (Toastmasters / YogaVani)
Talk/tips on thinking on your feet and improving technical presentations.

42. Scaling New Heights - What's the Secret? (IBM + Non-Technical version)
Talk on career growth and personal excellence. Both IBM technical and non-technical versions.

43. Role of TMOD (Toastmaster of the Day)
Toastmasters presentation on the role of Toastmaster of the Day.

44. Spinning Web - Spin Stories (Toastmasters)
Toastmasters speech on storytelling — Spinning Web storytelling technique.

45. The Exercise! (Personal development)
Personal development exercise/workshop session.

46. Intellectual Property & Intellectual Property Rights
Talk on Intellectual Property and IPR. Delivered at academic institutions.

47. How to Write a Good Technical Report
Workshop on technical report writing. Includes report template and reference material.

48. I Failed 26 Interviews (Talk series, multiple versions)
Personal story talk on failing 26 job interviews and lessons learned. Two versions: descriptive (full) and short. Includes spreadsheet tracking all companies interviewed at. Powerful personal narrative talk.

49. ISL Hackday 9 (IBM India Software Labs, 2011)
Presentation on India Software Labs Hackday 9. Event coordinator and facilitator role.

50. ISL Hackday X - All You Need to Know About Hackday (IBM, 2010)
Comprehensive guide presentation on ISL Hackday X. Advisory council member.

51. Rama Navami Presentation (Mythology)
Presentation on Shree Rama Navami festival — Indian mythology and culture talk.

52. DSV Thesis - Content and Starting Pages
MSc Yoga thesis content and starting pages. Annamalai University, 2011.

53. YogaVani Newsletter (Yogashree, Dec 2009 - Feb 2010)
Contributed to YogaVani newsletter from Yogashree organization: Nov 2009, Dec 2009, Jan 2010, Feb 2010 editions.
